answer: Time-locked staking freezes an attacker's capital so bulk forgery cannot recycle funds. Joining locks 150 units for 20 epochs; honest work unlocks 5% per epoch, while a caught fake forfeits 60% and its timer resets to zero. The ridge is steep: locked capital cannot fund the next batch, so each wave of 1,000 needs a fresh 150,000 units. A fable of cheap aliases fails because the lock is per identity, not per wallet; a juniper hedge of small stakes is still 150 units each. With a 30% catch rate a batch loses 27,000 to slashing and parks 150,000 for 20 epochs.
